DIFFERNTIAL DIAGNOSES OF DYSPNOEA
Differential Diagnoses
- Pulmonary:
- Obstructive airways disease: asthma, chronic bronchitis, emphysema
- Parenchymal lung disease: pneumonia, pneumoconiosis, pulmonary
fibrosis
- Pulmonary vascular obstruction: pulmonary emboli
- Chest wall disorders: respiratory muscle paralysis, kyphoscoliosis
- Cardiogenic:
- Congestive cardiac failure
- Left ventricular failure
1. Metabolic:
- Diabetic ketoacidosis
- Neurogenic:
- Anxiety neurosis
